# Forms, test data and the live site

**Sending a form on the live site does it for real.** Ask whether a test may send one; usually it runs
against a test copy (`BASE_URL=https://staging.example.com npm test`). Secrets come from the
environment, never the code: `SiteConfig.secret('password').then((p) => UserActions.typeSecret(DynamicLoadingDetailElements.PASSWORD_INPUT, p))`
reads `CYPRESS_password`, and the log never shows it. Data that differs between copies of the site:
`SiteConfig.value('productName', 'Blue shirt')`, set with `--expose productName=...`. Everything else: made-up values (`pat@example.com`).

**Data the team keeps** (accounts, policy numbers, products) is CSV in cypress/data/ (its README.md):
`TestData.reusable('policies.csv')` for rows any test may read, and `TestData.consumable('new-accounts.csv')`
for a row a test uses up, never given twice in a run; none left is a skip. `--expose environment=staging`
reads cypress/data/staging/ first: what differs between copies of the site goes there.

**Data that is not there is a skip, not a failure.** A test that needs data the site or the run may
not have (a policy with an amount due, an account not yet used) says so first, with the data in hand:
`cy.fixture('policies.json').then((policies) => Checks.assume(policies.length > 0, 'no policy with an
amount due in cypress/fixtures/policies.json'))`. When it is not there the test is skipped, its last step
"Skipped: ...", and cypress/report.html gives the reason. Name the data and where it comes from. An assume
is not a check: the test still checks something after it (SR-19).

**A form's data is one value.** Each form the crawl read has a record beside its page, named for the
form (`WriteToUs`), and its task takes it: `execute().fillWriteToUsForm(WriteToUs.sample())`. `sample()`
gives plausible values (each can be set for a run by its name, `--expose email=...`); change one field
with a spread, `{ ...WriteToUs.sample(), email: 'pat@example.com' }`, and check against the same value,
`form.email`. The record holds what a visitor types, nothing the site changes (an account used up, an
order number): that belongs to the story's test.
